title: A morphism of algebraic stacks is unramified exactly when it is locally of finite type with etale diagonal
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project — Morphisms of Algebraic Stacks

difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterises unramified morphisms of algebraic stacks as those which are locally of finite type and have etale diagonal (author lemma at source lines 8449-8457, label lemma-characterize-unramified). The proof (source lines 8459-8536) works with a DM presentation of the morphism in both directions: in the first direction it reads locally of finite type off an unramified morphism of algebraic spaces and proves etaleness of the diagonal after a smooth base change by exhibiting an etale presentation of that diagonal and descending along the etale localness on the source (proof lines 8485-8505); in the second direction it deduces from the etale diagonal that the map between the presenting spaces has etale diagonal, hence is an open immersion because etale monomorphisms are open immersions, which gives unramifiedness (proof lines 8507-8535). The two-way use of the presentation is the content. H3.
